exposure: Screening session (session 1: within six hours after birth, session 2: approximately three days after birth)
Timing of Otoacoustic Emissions (OAEs) screening (within six hours vs. approximately three days after birth)
outcome: Feasibility of screening in low-risk neonates
finding: Screening for hearing loss in low-risk neonates using OAEs is more feasible at the Midwife Obstetric Unit three-day assessment clinic compared to within hours of birth.
